properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.scheduling.enabled
properties.description: Enables the scheduler sending the emails. The scheduler also performs the retries and crash recovery for sendAsync; when it is disabled on a pod, another pod must run it against the same database.

properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.scheduling.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Enables cleanup of attachment files after sending.

properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.scheduling.interval
properties.description: Specifies the milliseconds delay between runs of the scheduler.

properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.scheduling.stuck-sending-recovery-threshold
properties.description: How long an email may stay in the SENDING state before being considered abandoned (crashed pod) and eligible to be re-claimed by another pod. Must comfortably exceed the worst-case SMTP send duration: JavaMail's default connect/read/write timeouts are infinite, so configure spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.connectiontimeout, spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.timeout and spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.writetimeout well below this threshold, otherwise a slow in-flight send can be re-claimed by another pod and delivered twice. This applies to sends of the after-commit dispatch as well.

properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.scheduling.stuck-cleanup-recovery-threshold
properties.description: How long an email may keep its attachment-cleanup lock before the cleanup is considered abandoned (crashed pod) and eligible to be re-claimed. Must comfortably exceed the worst-case duration of releasing all attachments of a single email, otherwise a slow in-flight cleanup can be re-claimed by another pod and its attachments released twice (harmless only if `AttachmentDataSource.releaseAttachment` is idempotent).

properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.async-dispatch.enabled
properties.description: Sends emails queued via ManageEmail.sendAsync right after the caller's transaction committed, on a bounded executor. When disabled, such emails are sent by the scheduler only; recommended for tests. On shutdown the library waits up to 30 seconds for queued and in-flight sends; whatever is left is picked up by the scheduler.

properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.async-dispatch.threads
properties.description: Number of threads of the executor sending emails right after commit, i.e. how many SMTP sends run in parallel per pod. The default of one matches the scheduler, which sends sequentially.

properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.async-dispatch.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of emails waiting for a thread of the after-commit executor. When the queue is full, the hand-off is dropped and the scheduler sends the email instead.

properties.name: aboutbits.emailservice.scheduling.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of send attempts before an email is marked as ERROR. Applies to sendAsync and schedule; the attempt right after commit counts as the first one. sendOrFail makes exactly one attempt and is never retried. Failed attempts are retried with exponential backoff (scheduling.interval x 2^attempts); with the defaults a persistently failing email runs attempt 1 -> +60s -> attempt 2 -> +120s -> attempt 3 -> ERROR.
